Title: Implement Agent Think-Aloud Logs for Context Window Detection
Description: Build monitoring to detect when LLMs start repeating work or losing context. The think-aloud protocol in character agents provides diagnostic capability beyond explainability. Detect patterns: agent repeating earlier work, forgetting extracted objects, circular reasoning. Create early warning system for context exhaustion.

Title: Formalize Three-Tier HITL Pipeline Architecture
Description: Document and implement the three distinct HITL pipelines with clear separation of concerns: 1) Object Model Governance (Core) - schema evolution and canonical definitions, 2) Research Content (Platform) - instance validation and quality control, 3) Implementation Testing (Duckie) - BDD scenarios and GitHub integration. Prevents validation chaos.

Title: Build Context Window Monitoring Dashboard
Description: Create dashboard showing context health across extraction sessions. Include metrics for repetition rate, attribution accuracy, reasoning quality degradation. Provide early warning system for context exhaustion with quantifiable metrics for optimizing prompt length vs context preservation.

Title: Implement Automatic Session Chunking on Context Degradation
Description: When context degradation detected through think-aloud analysis, automatically chunk sessions at natural breakpoints. Use HITL stages as context boundaries. Prevents rework spiral where LLM keeps revising same content and maintains extraction quality.

Title: Create Agent Diagnostic Tooling for Prompt Debugging
Description: Build tools to analyze agent think-aloud logs for patterns. Detect quality degradation, context loss, reasoning failures. Support QE debugging workflows when character agents produce incorrect outputs. Enable tracing from malformed outputs back to prompt issues.

Title: Implement Validation Pipeline for Agent Prompts
Description: Create automated process to ensure example outputs within each agent's prompt file are valid against corresponding JSON schemas. Prevents prompt drift and ensures agents are trained on valid, up-to-date examples. Integrate into CI/CD pipeline to fail builds on invalid prompt examples.
